name: ecs-ai-workbench

scripts.mac:pack: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios && npm run ios:register-plugin
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios

description: A multi-device prototype for a lightweight AI workbench that connects to an Alibaba Cloud ECS over SSH and controls remote CLI agents such as Codex CLI, Claude CLI, or custom commands.
